**Special Abilities**

 **Channel Awareness (Su)
  An avernal ghoul automatically senses when it is in the area of a channel energy ability if that ability is being used to affect undead (whether positive or negative energy).  Disease (Su)** *Ghoul Fever*: Bite–injury; *save* Fort DC 14; onset 1 day; *frequency* 1 day; *effect* 1d3 Con and 1d3 Dex damage; *cure* 2 consecutive saves. The save DC is Charisma-based.
